astro.insufficient_birth_data: Ise sahi se calculate karne ke liye mere paas poori jaankari nahin hai — kya hum ise poora kar lein?

astro.engine_unavailable: Calculation seva abhi thodi der ke liye available nahin hai. Thodi der mein dobara try karein.
astro.provider_disputed: Hamare sources is detail par abhi poori tarah sehmat nahin hain, isliye hum guess karne ki bajaye dobara jaanch rahe hain.

astro.name_invalid: Is naam mein aise characters hain jo hum naam ki tarah nahin padh pa rahe. Check karke dobara koshish karein.

voice.session_not_found: Woh baatcheet ab khuli nahi hai. Nayi shuru karein, Tara aage badha dengi.

sys.validation: Request mein kuch theek nahin tha. Dobara koshish karein.

safety.crisis: Mujhe batane ke liye shukriya. Is baat ke liye sahi madad main nahin hoon, aur main nahin chahti ki aap ise akele sahein. Aise waqt ke liye trained log hain, aur main aapko abhi unse jod sakti hoon — “Support lein” dabaiye. Main yahin aapke saath hoon.

memorial.title: Unhein smriti mein rakhein
memorial.body: {name} aapke parivaar mein bani rahengi — unke janm-vivaran, unki kundli, aur unke baare mein jo kuch likha ja chuka hai, sab waisa hi.
memorial.keeps: Kuch bhi nahin mitta. Na koi vivaran, na koi note, na aapki journal ki ek pankti.
memorial.reminders: Bas ek baat badalti hai: Tara unka janmdin aur saalgirah aane waali taareekhon ki tarah saamne nahin laayegi, aur unke baare mein beete hue samay mein baat karegi.

memorial.revert_title: {name} ko parivaar ki suchi mein lautayein
memorial.revert_body: Unka janmdin aur saalgirah phir aane waali taareekhon ki tarah dikhenge. Aur kuch nahin badalta, kyunki kuch kabhi liya hi nahin gaya tha.
memorial.or: Ya, agar aap chaahti hain ki record hi na rahe:
